mechanism: Selegiline (MAOI) combined with mefloquine (which has CNS effects and potential serotonergic activity) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS toxicity.
action: Avoid this combination; use alternative antimalarial agents (atovaquone-proguanil, doxycycline, or artemether-lumefantrine) if mefloquine is considered necessary, and ensure adequate washout period if switching agents.
